headline: Big Tech Firms Like Oracle Turn to Bonds to Finance A.I. Data Centers
context: Risk is rising as big tech companies like Oracle — the ultimate financial source of the Ellison media empire — need to turn to the bond market for staggering sums to finance data centers.
